items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: That's how I happened to meet Charlie Creath and Zutty and them guys around there, in 1925.

ctx.x: Around Algiers and all them other little old towns, in Reserve or... Any little town. Because we played East St. Louis, and I would get tired of staying on that bus, and we'd come into St. Louis. That's how I happened to meet Charlie Creath and Zutty and them guys around there, in 1925.
We're going to get to that a little bit later. Let me just pursue this a bit further with Doc Moon.

items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: Zooty had been playing in St. Louis though, I hadn't been playing with those guys, but they was talking about him.

ctx.x: Joe Poston? Yeah. Just playing with Jimmy New York? He was playing saxophone. Yeah? Yeah.

And Zooty, Zooty had been around St. Louis just before then. It was really in Chicago last time. Well, Zooty had been playing in St. Louis though, I hadn't been playing with those guys, but they was talking about him. Then I played around there for a long, uh, not, well, not too long. Then I went to, uh, Harrisburg, Illinois with, with a bunch of guys and started working for these gangsters, Charlie Berger and his gang.
Yeah. Well, I'll tell them, tell us about St. Louis.
